camel_example: aliyun sas DescribeDomainSecureVulList --region cn-hangzhou --Type app --SourceIp '111.196.0.0' --Lang zh --From sas
description_en: Queries the vulnerability list in a website security report
description_zh: 查询网站安全报告的漏洞列表
kebab_example: aliyun sas describe-domain-secure-vul-list --source-ip 111.196.0.0 --lang zh --from sas --type app --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDomainSecureVulList

parameters.help_en: The IP address of the access source
parameters.name: source_ip

parameters.help_en:
The language type of the request and response. Default value: zh. Valid values:
zh: Chinese
en: English
parameters.help_zh:
设置请求和接收消息的语言类型，默认为zh。取值：
zh：中文
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The identifier of the request source. Set the value to sas
parameters.name: from

parameters.help_en:
The vulnerability type. Valid values:
app: application vulnerability
parameters.help_zh:
漏洞类型。取值包括：
app：应用漏洞
parameters.name: type

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request. The ID is a unique identifier that Alibaba Cloud generates for the request and can be used to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of vulnerabilities returned

VulList.description_en: The list of vulnerabilities associated with the domain name

items.description_en: The list of vulnerabilities associated with the domain name

AsapCount.description_zh: 修复优先级为高的漏洞的数量

GmtLast.description_en: The timestamp when the vulnerability was last detected, in milliseconds
GmtLast.description_zh: 漏洞最后发现的时间戳，单位为毫秒

LaterCount.description_zh: 修复优先级为中的漏洞的数量

NntfCount.description_zh: 修复优先级为低的漏洞的数量

Type.description_en:
The type of the vulnerability to query. Default value: cve. Valid values:

cve: Linux software vulnerability
sys: Windows system vulnerability
cms: Web-CMS vulnerability
app: application vulnerability (network scan)
sca: application vulnerability (software constituency parsing)

sys：Windows漏洞
cms：WebCMS漏洞
app：应用漏洞（网络扫描）
sca：应用漏洞（软件成分分析）
